name: Moosling · Gremlet #42
description:
A gangly moose calf that's mostly legs and nose. Its antlers are still velvet nubs.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Moosling in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
